DOWNFALL-BIG_SHOT_POWER.title: Smoking Barrel

DOWNFALL-BRAWL_POWER.title: Brawl

DOWNFALL-BRUISE_POWER.title: Bruised
DOWNFALL-BRUISE_POWER.description: Takes more Attack damage this turn.

DOWNFALL-COALESCENCE_POWER.title: Coalescence

DOWNFALL-CONCENTRATED_POWER.title: Concentration

DOWNFALL-DETERMINATION_POWER.title: Determination

DOWNFALL-RUGGED_POWER.title: Rugged
